seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: the practice of liners using this track when in the vicinity of ice at night had been in clear weather to keep the course, to maintain the speed and to trust to a sharp lookout ... This practice, it was said, had been justified by experience, no casualties having resulted from it.
seeds.external_lens_identity: Normalization of deviance (Diane Vaughan); safety drift from repeated success
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: 这里不只是“判断失误”，而是长期无事故把高风险做法慢慢正常化：因为以前一直没出事，继续高速穿越冰区就被当成可接受常规。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，这段不再只是为 Smith 辩护，而是在交代一个制度化学习偏差：历史上的“成功”遮蔽了做法本身已经越过安全边界。
source_leads: Diane Vaughan, The Challenger Launch Decision (1996)

seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: Being a message affecting navigation, it should in the ordinary course have been taken to the bridge... it was never heard of by anyone on board the Titanic outside the Marconi room.
seeds.external_lens_identity: Swiss cheese model of accidents (James Reason); latent organizational failure across handoffs
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: 灾难机制不只是一名值班员漏看冰山，而是多道信息关口同时失灵：无线员、船桥、图海室、文件传递规则各自只漏一点，最后拼成致命缺口。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，多条“消息没送到/送晚了”的细节会连成一条事故链；原文里的零散失误变成了可解释的系统性穿孔。
source_leads: James Reason, Managing the Risks of Organizational Accidents (1997)
关键词："Swiss cheese model" handoff latent failure

seeds.source_anchor_quote_en: the accepted mail steamers outward track ... passes about 25 miles south ... of the area marked "field ice" ... but from 100 to 300 miles to the northward ... of the dotted line ... "Icebergs have been seen within this line".
seeds.external_lens_identity: Goodhart-style proxy failure / optimizing to a charted boundary instead of the underlying hazard
seeds.mechanism_claim_zh: 航线制度把“避开图上更稳定、更易标示的 field ice 边界”当成了可操作目标，但真正致命的危险是分布更散、更难预测的 iceberg；代理指标替代了真实风险。
seeds.reread_delta_zh: 重读后，航线并非单纯‘靠近危险’，而是暴露出一种治理偏差：可画线、可协商的风险被优先管理，不易标准化的风险被留在系统里。
source_leads: Charles Goodhart, discussions of Goodhart's law (1975 onward)
关键词：proxy measure target failure safety management
也可查：Marilyn Strathern on audit/target effects
